title: Inventing the Computer Mouse | Douglas Engelbart | Talks at Google
summary: A Talks at Google visit by Douglas Engelbart, inventor of the mouse. He presents his lifelong aim of augmenting collective human intelligence, followed by a Q&A.
why: Recommended for hearing Engelbart's vision of collaborative hypertext systems straight from him, including his view of Wikipedia.

quote.text: Inspirational ideas (unfortunately displayed with slides instead of Hyperdoc demos) and perplexed reactions in the ending Q&A session.
